sloka: आयसीं तु गदां वीरः प्रगृह्य कनकाङ्गदः।शोणिताक्षः समाविध्य तमेवानुपपात ह ।। ६.७६.१२ ।।
transliteration: āyasīṁ tu gadāṁ vīraḥ pragṛhya kanakāṅgadaḥ।śoṇitākṣaḥ samāvidhya tamevānupapāta ha ।। 6.76.12 ।।

translations.english: Sonitha adorned with golden armlets taking hold of iron mace rushed behind Angada.
